Meta.title: REAGE — Network of Algerian executives and entrepreneurs in Europe
Meta.description: REAGE connects the Algerian diaspora in Europe with Algeria: a network of executives and entrepreneurs serving economy, entrepreneurship and training.

hero.kicker: Network of the Algerian diaspora in Europe
hero.title: Connecting Algerian talent, here and there.
hero.subtitle: REAGE brings together Algerian executives and entrepreneurs in Europe to build lasting ties with Algeria, share knowledge and grow a network of trust.

about.title: A bridge between the diaspora and Algeria
about.body: A non-profit association founded in 2006, REAGE brings together people committed to Algeria's economic development. We enable connections, the exchange of expertise and mentoring — with no partisan affiliation, in the sole service of skills and projects.

what.title: What we do
what.subtitle: Three levers at the heart of our work.

network.title: Network
network.body: Connecting diaspora professionals with one another and with economic players in Algeria.

entrepreneurship.title: Entrepreneurship
entrepreneurship.body: Supporting initiatives, innovation and projects that create value on both shores of the Mediterranean.

training.title: Training
training.body: Sharing knowledge through training and mentoring tailored to real needs.

events.subtitle: Meetings, conferences and network gatherings.

support.title: Your support moves the network forward
support.body: Every donation helps REAGE host gatherings, mentor project leaders and strengthen ties between Europe and Algeria. Payments are securely handled by HelloAsso — no money passes through this site.
support.note: Membership and support securely handled by HelloAsso.
